note: Package manifest for the JAH MCP pilot server: the 10 pilot database entries only. database_count is the LIVE network count at packaging time (63,047); the pilot serves these 10 databases / 160 records.

databases.name: The Biofonics Database
databases.tagline: Sixteen full biofonics record records: What Is Biofonics; The Dawn Chorus; Bernie Krause and the Biophony Concept; Birdsong: Learning and Repertoire; Frog Choruses and Amphibian Calls; Insect Sound: Crickets and Cicadas; Bat Echolocation; Whale Song and Ocean Bioacoustics; Elephant Infrasound; The Acoustic Niche Hypothesis; Soundscape Indices: NDSI and ACI; Bioacoustics Field Recording Methods; Noise Pollution and the Anthrophony Layer; Coral Reef Soundscapes; Biofonics Conservation: Listening as Monitoring; Biofonics Field Guide Index.

databases.name: The Soundscape Ecology Database
databases.tagline: Sixteen full records on soundscapes and their three layers, kept distinct and cross-linked: biophony, geophony, and anthrophony, the acoustic niche hypothesis, habitat comparison, dawn chorus, urban, freshwater, and marine soundscapes, seasons, indices, noise pollution, restoration, quiet parks, and sources.
